name: Gem
tagline: Gem is a talent acquisition platform that combines AI-powered sourcing, CRM, and analytics for recruiting teams. It helps recruiters find and engage candidates across LinkedIn and other channels, track relationship history, and measure pipeline health with advanced reporting.
